relations.subject: Andrej Vostrikov
relations.evidence: A second main disciple of Stcherbatsky for Tibetology was Andrej Vostrikov (1904–1937).

relations.subject: Kalyanov
relations.evidence: Kalyanov, and ex-student of Stcherbatsky (after the death of his teacher).

relations.evidence: For support with Tibetan art, he relied on his son George Roerich

relations.evidence: he learned Lamaist iconography from Lama Lobsang Mingyur Dorje in Darjeeling.

relations.subject: Bazar Baradijn
relations.evidence: In order to prevent further destruction of monastic libraries, the special archive was established, which later, in 1922, was turned into the Scientific Committee. The first head of this establishment was the well-known Russian orientalist Bazar Baradijn (1878–1938).
